facts.text: The University of the Incarnate Word is the largest Catholic university in Texas and fields the only Catholic NCAA Division I athletics program in the South.

sources.title: About UIW | About UIW - University of the Incarnate Word
sources.quote: UIW is the largest Catholic university in Texas and the fourth largest private university in Texas.

sources.title: About UIW | About UIW - University of the Incarnate Word
sources.quote: UIW is the only Catholic NCAA Division 1 athletics program in the South, and counts 15 sports and 24 men's and women's teams.
